question: Through which of the following states does the Chambal river, a tributary of Yamuna river, NOT pass?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujrat.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Chambal River** is a branch of the **Yamuna River** in central India, and thus forms part of the greater Gangetic drainage system.
 
• **It does not pass through the Gujrat.**
 
• The river flows through the states of** Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh in a north-northeast direction.**
 
• From its origin it flows** north into southeastern Rajasthan state.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The state of **Uttar Pradesh** has got thirty one rivers flowing through the place, which includes both long as well as small rivers.
 
• Some important rivers of **Rajasthan** are** Kali, Banas, Banganga, Parvati, Gambhiri, Mahi, Kakni, Jokham, Sabarmati, Katli, Sabi and Mantha.**
 
• In **Madhya pradesh**, these rivers are flow** Narmada (Shahdol district), Tapti (Betul District), Mahi (Dhar district), Godawari (Wainganga - Balaghat District).​ **
